moves.label: Trade: Buddy Hield, Klay Thompson, Josh Green, Kyle Anderson, Buddy Hield and others
moves.description: A 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own) was acquired by the Philadelphia Sixers in exchange for Buddy Hield. Klay Thompson and a More Favorable 2025 2nd round pick were acquired by the Dallas Mavericks in exchange for Josh Green and a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own). Kyle Anderson and Buddy Hield were acquired by the Golden State Warriors in exchange for Klay Thompson, a Swap 2031 2nd round picks and cash. Josh Green, Reggie Jackson, a 2029 2nd round pick (DEN own) and a 2030 2nd round pick (DEN own) were acquired by the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for a 2025 2nd round pick (PHL own) and cash. A 2025 2nd round pick (PHL own), cash and a TPE were acquired by the Denver Nuggets in exchange for Reggie Jackson, a More Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a 2029 2nd round pick (DEN own) and a 2030 2nd round pick (DEN own). A Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a Swap 2031 2nd round picks, cash and a TPE were acquired by the Minnesota Timberwolves in exchange for Kyle Anderson.

moves.label: Trade: Quentin Grimes, Tim Hardaway Jr.
moves.description: Quentin Grimes and a TPE were acquired by the Dallas Mavericks from the Detroit Pistons in exchange for: Tim Hardaway Jr., a 2025 2nd round pick (TOR own), a Least Favorable 2028 2nd round pick and a 2028 2nd round pick (MIA own).

moves.label: Trade: Malaki Branham, Tyus Jones, Anthony Davis, Dante Exum, Jaden Hardy and others
moves.description: Malaki Branham and a TPE were acquired by the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for Tyus Jones. Anthony Davis, Dante Exum, Jaden Hardy and D'Angelo Russell were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for Marvin Bagley III, Malaki Branham, A.J. Johnson, Khris Middleton, a Least Favorable 2026 1st round pick, a 2026 2nd round pick (PHX own), a conditional 2027 2nd round pick (CHI own), a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own), a conditional 2030 1st round pick (GOS own) and a TPE. Marvin Bagley III, A.J. Johnson, Tyus Jones, Khris Middleton, a Least Favorable 2026 1st round pick, a 2026 2nd round pick (PHX own), a conditional 2027 2nd round pick (CHI own), a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own), a conditional 2030 1st round pick (GOS own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Dallas Mavericks in exchange for Anthony Davis, Dante Exum, Jaden Hardy and D'Angelo Russell.

moves.description: The draft rights to Koa Peat was acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for a More Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a 2029 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2033 2nd round pick (PHX own) and cash. The draft rights to Sergio De Larrea was acquired by the Dallas Mavericks in exchange for the draft rights to Melvin Ajinca, the draft rights to Koa Peat, a 2030 2nd round pick (PHL own) and a 2032 2nd round pick (DAL own). The draft rights to Cameron Carr was acquired by the Los Angeles Lakers in exchange for the draft rights to Sergio De Larrea, the draft rights to Chinemelu Elonu, the draft rights to Louis Labeyrie and cash. The draft rights to Melvin Ajinca, the draft rights to Chinemelu Elonu, the draft rights to Louis Labeyrie, a More Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a 2029 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2030 2nd round pick (PHL own), a 2032 2nd round pick (DAL own), a 2033 2nd round pick (PHX own) and cash were acquired by the New York Knicks in exchange for the draft rights to Cameron Carr.

moves.label: Trade: John Collins, Santi Aldama, Marcus Sasser, Tarik Biberovic, A.J. Johnson and others
moves.description: A conditional 2030 2nd round pick (DET own) and a TPE were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for John Collins and cash. Santi Aldama, Marcus Sasser and the draft rights to Tarik Biberovic were acquired by the Dallas Mavericks in exchange for A.J. Johnson, Khris Middleton, a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own), a conditional 2030 1st round pick (GOS own) and a 2033 2nd round pick (DAL own). Khris Middleton, a 2033 2nd round pick (DAL own) and a TPE were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for D'Angelo Russell, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAL own), a Swap 2032 2nd round picks, a 2033 2nd round pick (WAS own) and a TPE. Caris LeVert, a 2027 2nd round pick (MIL own) and cash were acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Gary Harris and Taurean Prince. A.J. Johnson, D'Angelo Russell, Isaiah Stewart II, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAL own), a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own), a conditional 2030 1st round pick (GOS own), a Swap 2032 2nd round picks and a 2033 2nd round pick (WAS own) were acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Santi Aldama, the draft rights to Tarik Biberovic, a 2029 2nd round pick (DET own), a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own) and a 2032 2nd round pick (DET own). John Collins, Gary Harris, Taurean Prince, a Least Favorable 2027 2nd round pick, a 2029 2nd round pick (DET own), a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own), a 2032 2nd round pick (DET own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for Caris LeVert, Marcus Sasser, Isaiah Stewart II, a Least Favorable 2027 2nd round pick, a 2027 2nd round pick (MIL own) and a conditional 2030 2nd round pick (DET own).
